# expo_android_keystore (Resource)

Uploads an Android upload/signing keystore to the EAS account. Reference its `id` from `expo_android_app_credentials.build_credentials.keystore_id`. EAS has no API to read a keystore back by id, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected; every argument forces a new keystore.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "expo_android_keystore" "release" {
  keystore_base64   = filebase64("${path.module}/release.jks")
  keystore_password = var.keystore_password
  key_alias         = "upload"
  key_password      = var.key_password
}

output "release_sha1" {
  value = expo_android_keystore.release.sha1_certificate_fingerprint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_alias` (String) Alias of the signing key inside the keystore.
- `keystore_base64` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded keystore file (`.jks` / `.keystore`), e.g. `filebase64("release.jks")`.
- `keystore_password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the keystore.

### Optional

- `key_password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the signing key. Omit if it is the same as the keystore password.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) EAS Id of the Android Keystore
- `md5_certificate_fingerprint` (String) MD5 fingerprint of the signing certificate.
- `sha1_certificate_fingerprint` (String) SHA-1 fingerprint of the signing certificate (e.g. for registering the app in Firebase).
- `sha256_certificate_fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the signing certificate.
